title: Aveline 8" gel infused memory foam twin
text: Aveline 8" gel infused memory foam twin. I purchased 2 bunk bed sets for my grandsons, twins over fulls... As I believe memory foam mattresses are the only way to sleep, I invested these, 2 fulls, 2 twins.  They are both 8" thick.... gel infused.  I chose the 8" because they will fit better in the bunk beds and also for weight... obviously the thicker ones weigh more.  I sent them to my daughter in Arizona, love that Amazon makes it easy for me to help her.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition, rolled up and condensed.  When you unroll them they fluff right up. I also purchased some waterproof zipper mattress covers to help protect the investment.. my youngest is just beginning potty training... accidents happen!  I never hesitate to update my reviews if any new info would be helpful.  Further, I do NOT receive any compensation for my reviews, ever.

features: COOLING MATTRESS - Aveline comes with gel-infused memory foam top layer that is open cell and ventilated. Sleep comfortably while reducing sweat and perspiration during hot or humid weather.
SLEEP SOUNDLY - Reduce pressure on your head, neck and spine with an open cell memory foam queen mattress. Aveline helps align your spine and reduce pressure on your hips, lower back and shoulders.
Full Dimensions: 75" L x 54" W x 10" H
INDEPENDENTLY TESTED - The foam inside is CertiPUR-US certified so you can be sure it’s made without formaldehyde, heavy metals, PBDEs, TDCPP or TCEP (”Tris”) flame retardants, and is low on VOC.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION - Over 98% of Aveline customers are satisfied with their purchase and buy more as the need arises. Back that up with our 10-year manufacturer warranty, and you can rest easy knowing you are purchasing a quality mattress at an exceptional price.
Aveline delivers high quality memory foam comfort and support at a price you can afford.
description: Take a deep breath and exhale because you've found your pathway to that perfect sleep with the Aveline 10 inch pressure relief memory foam mattress. Topped with gel-infused memory foam to keep your body climate steady, this firm 10 inch mattress dissipates your body heat while quickly conforming to your weight and position. Sleep peacey with an open cell ventilated memory foam solution that relieves pressure points, reduces bounce between two sleepers, and delivers welcome relief from the aches and pains of traditional mattresses. Aveline cooling gel mattress is CertiPUR-US certified by accredited independent testing laboratories, so you can be confident that the memory foam is made without formaldehyde, ozone depleters, mercury, and other heavy metals including PBDEs, TDCPP or TCEP (”Tris”) flame retardants, and is low on VOC. This 10 inch memory foam mattress comes vacuum-packed and rolled to fit into an easily portable box. It takes 2 to 4 hours for the gel mattress from your bed in a box to expand most of the way and a day to expand y. Includes a removable stretch knit diamond patterned cover. Box spring or foundation is optional. Slatted bases should be less than 3" apart.
